New feature

[**One place for every project conversation**](https://intercom.news/companycam/155515-one-place-for-every-project-conversation#)

![Jose avatar](https://static.intercomassets.com/avatars/6745053/original/Jose_Avatar_2025-1762182732.png)

Shared by Jose
• August 27, 2026

Every conversation on a project now lives in one place. The new Conversations Hub, found in the left nav on web and the chat bubble on mobile, is now live. You can reply, mention teammates, and attach photos, checklists, or files without leaving the thread or hopping between projects to track down who said what. If you've ever dug through texts, emails, and old comments trying to find where a conversation left off, this puts it all in one feed sorted by what's new and unread. It's live for every user on mobile and desktop now.

[Read more](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/15627142-using-the-conversations-hub)
